name: ecovoltx
description: EcoVoltX — Multi-tenant EV charging platform for residential societies, powered by EcoNelssol

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin,resident -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run server" "npm run admin" "npm run resident"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix admin-dashboard install && npm --prefix resident-app install
scripts.build: npm --prefix admin-dashboard run build && npm --prefix resident-app run build
scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && npm run db:setup
